SELECT p.product_id, p.product_categories_id, p.product_name, p.product_price, p.product_cover, p.product_introduction, CAST( CONCAT( '[', GROUP_CONCAT( JSON_OBJECT( 'specificationTypeId', st.specification_type_id, 'type', st.specification_type_name, 'values', ( SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG( JSON_OBJECT( 'specificationValueId', sv2.specification_value_id, 'value', sv2.specs, 'addPrice', sv2.attr ) ) FROM ms_specification_value sv2 WHERE sv2.specification_type_id = st.specification_type_id AND sv2.del_flag = 0 ) ) SEPARATOR ',' ), ']' ) AS JSON ) AS specs_and_attrs FROM ms_product p INNER JOIN ms_store_product sp ON p.product_id = sp.product_id INNER JOIN ms_specification s ON p.specification_id = s.specification_id INNER JOIN ms_specification_type st ON s.specification_id = st.specification_id WHERE p.status = 1 AND sp.store_id = #{storeId} AND st.del_flag = 0
AND p.product_categories_id = #{productCategoriesId}
AND ( p.keyword = #{keyWord} OR p.product_name LIKE concat('%', #{keyWord}, '%') )
GROUP BY p.product_id

SELECT p.product_id, c.categories_name, p.product_name, p.product_price, p.product_cover, p.product_carousel, p.product_introduction, p.product_description, p.earn_points, CAST( CONCAT( '[', GROUP_CONCAT( JSON_OBJECT( 'specificationTypeId', st.specification_type_id, 'type', st.specification_type_name, 'values', ( SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG( JSON_OBJECT( 'specificationValueId', sv.specification_value_id, 'value', sv.specs, 'addPrice', sv.attr ) ) FROM ms_specification_value sv WHERE sv.specification_type_id = st.specification_type_id AND sv.del_flag = 0 ) ) SEPARATOR ',' ), ']' ) AS JSON ) AS specs_and_attrs FROM ms_product p INNER JOIN ms_specification s ON p.specification_id = s.specification_id INNER JOIN ms_specification_type st ON s.specification_id = st.specification_id INNER JOIN ms_categories c ON p.product_categories_id = c.categories_id WHERE p.product_id = #{id} AND p.del_flag = 0 AND p.status = 1 AND st.del_flag = 0 GROUP BY p.product_id
